### An autonomous investigator configured to your specific typology, data sources, regulatory environment, and evidentiary standards. Designed for the cases the workforce does not cover off-the-shelf.

Talk to Our Investigation Design Team

### When You Need It

The Investigation Workforce and Programs cover the most common risk typologies. But some institutions face requirements that are unique to their risk profile, jurisdiction, or business model.

The Custom Investigator is built for these cases. Our investigation and compliance leadership designs a specialist that follows your methodology, queries your data sources, and produces output that meets your standards.

## How It Works

						01					

													Investigation Design

																			Your team defines typology, evidentiary requirements, data sources, and regulatory standards. Tangos translates these into a structured Investigation Playbook.

						02					

													Specialist Configuration

																			An AI Specialist is configured to execute the playbook — with access to the registries, feeds, and intelligence sources your investigation requires.

						03					

													Validation

																			The investigator runs against historical cases from your portfolio. Your team reviews the output and validates against your compliance standard.

						04					

													Deployment

																			Available as a Managed Service (Tangos runs it) or as a Platform Subscription (your team operates it via the dashboard). Air-gap capable.

## Every institution has investigations that are uniquely its own.

Tell us what you need investigated. We will show you how the engine handles it.

Build the Investigator

Tangos is building the investigation intelligence engine for the world's most important institutions. The work is hard. The stakes are real. The team is small and the problems are large.

Why Tangos

Financial crime funds human trafficking, terrorism, sanctions evasion, and fraud at global scale. The institutions tasked with investigating it are overwhelmed. We change that equation — with an engine that reasons through cases the way the best human investigators do.

Investigation intelligence at institutional scale sits at the intersection of AI reasoning, regulatory compliance, evidence construction, and adversarial systems. Mistakes have real regulatory and legal implications.

75+ combined years in financial crime and sanctions. Former investigators, compliance officers, sanctions analysts, and enforcement professionals — alongside engineers who understand what it means to build for regulated environments.

What We Value in People

Judgment over speed. Precision, not velocity.
Ownership over process. Responsibility for outcomes.
Curiosity over certainty. Ask good questions. Follow the evidence. Challenge your own hypotheses.
Craft over shortcuts. The institutions we serve notice the difference.

Are you a good fit?

We’re constantly growing and looking for uniquely talented people which we build roles around their skills.

If you strongly feel that this describes you, send us a note.
